rationale: Engagement with epilepsy apps is known to halve seizure frequency in sustained users (c6), so a scoping review should map how clinics can raise engagement.
alternatives: Systematic review of engagement and seizure outcomes
whyNotMoreComplex: A systematic review is not needed when the effect is already established.

decision.statement: Run a scoping review on raising engagement, because sustained engagement halves seizure frequency (c6).
decision.question: Should the clinic run a scoping review of app engagement?

gates.evidence: Library request NSL-2026-118, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Systematic review of engagement and seizure outcomes

summary: Scoping review recommended; the decision cites c6.
